content.text: Three steps, using your tools: (1) search X for posts by @nodejs from the last two weeks and pick the one about a release; (2) search the web and open the official nodejs.org blog post for that release to get its exact release date; (3) with the code interpreter, compute how many days passed between that release date and 2026-11-09. Answer in 4 short sentences, citing the post and the page.
